secureHelp: Inkinobho ivula ikhasi lapho ungakhetha khona iphasiwedi entsha. Ngemuva kwalokho, vula i-Vaultara, uye ku-Iphrofayela > Ukuphepha nobumfihlo > Amadivayisi akho bese uthepha u-Phuma kuwo wonke amanye amadivayisi.
support: Phendula le imeyili noma uxhumane no-{supportEmail}.
securityFooter: Sithumela le imeyili ukuze sigcine i-akhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara iphephile. Awukwazi ukuvala lezi imeyili.
billingFooter: Sithumela le imeyili ukuze uhlale wazi ukuthi kwenzekani ngokubhalisa kwakho kwe-Vaultara.
newSignInBody: Kusanda kungenwa ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara kusukela kudivayisi esingakaze siyibone ngaphambili.
passwordChangedBody: Iphasiwedi ye-akhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara isanda kushintshwa.
emailChangeRequestedBody: Kwenziwe isicelo sokushintsha i-imeyili ku-akhawunti yakho.
emailChangeRequestedBodyTo: Kwenziwe isicelo sokushintsha i-imeyili ku-akhawunti yakho ibe ngu-{maskedNewEmail}.
twoStepDisabledBody: Ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili kusanda kuvalwa ku-akhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara. Manje ukungena kudinga iphasiwedi yakho kuphela.
sessionsRevokedBody: I-akhawunti yakho ye-Vaultara isanda kuphuma kuwo wonke amadivayisi ngaphandle kwaleyo esetshenziselwe ukwenza lolu shintsho.
includedPremium: I-Premium ifaka amarekhodi nezigaba ezingenamkhawulo, izithombe ezinamathiselwe, izixhumanisi zokwabelana nezikhumbuzo ezithuthukisiwe.
includedFamily: I-Family ifaka konke okuku-Premium, kanye namarekhodi nezikhumbuzo okwabelwana ngakho komuzi wakho wonke.
includedBusiness: I-Business ifaka konke okuku-Family, kanye nezikhumbuzo zabasebenzi, izicelo zokubuyekeza nemibiko yokuhambisana nemithetho.
receiptGoogle: I-Google Play ikuthumelela irisidi esemthethweni enenani elikhokhisiwe.
receiptApple: I-Apple ikuthumelela irisidi esemthethweni enenani elikhokhisiwe.
startedBody: Siyabonga ngokubhalisa. Uhlelo lwakho lwe-{plan} manje luyasebenza.
renewedBody: Uhlelo lwakho lwe-{plan} luvuselelwe. Siyabonga ngokuhlala ne-Vaultara.
yearlyReminderSubject: Uhlelo lwakho lwe-Vaultara {plan} luzovuselelwa ezinsukwini ezi-7
yearlyReminderBody: Uhlelo lwakho lonyaka lwe-{plan} luzovuselelwa ngo-{date}. Uma ufuna ukulugcina, awudingi ukwenza lutho. Uma ufuna ukulushintsha noma ukulukhansela, ungakwenza lokho ngaphambi kosuku lokuvuselela.
cancelledBody: Ukuvuselela okuzenzakalelayo manje kuvaliwe ohlelweni lwakho lwe-{plan}. Uhlala unokufinyelela okugcwele kuze kube ngu-{date}. Ngemuva kwalokho, i-akhawunti yakho iya ohlelweni lwe-Mahhala futhi amarekhodi akho ahlala ephephile.
resumedBody: Ukuvuselela okuzenzakalelayo kuvuliwe futhi ohlelweni lwakho lwe-{plan}. Siyabonga ngokuhlala ne-Vaultara.
endedBody: Uhlelo lwakho lwe-{plan} luphelile futhi i-akhawunti yakho manje isohlelweni lwe-Mahhala. Amarekhodi akho asesekhona ku-akhawunti yakho. Ungabhalisa futhi nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ku-app.
refundedBody: Ukuthenga kohlelo lwakho lwe-{plan} kubuyiselwe imali. Ukufinyelela obekuze nalokhu kuthenga kuphelile.
deleteBody: Sithole isicelo sokususa i-akhawunti ye-Vaultara esebenzisa leli kheli le-imeyili. Ukuze uqhubeke, vula isixhumanisi esingezansi. Ungabuyekeza okuzosuswa ngaphambi kokuthi uqinisekise.
deleteExpiry: Isixhumanisi sisebenza kanye futhi siphelelwa yisikhathi ehoreni eli-1.
deleteNotYou: Uma ungacelanga lokhu, ungayishaya indiva le imeyili. I-akhawunti yakho ihlala injengoba injalo.
deleteFooter: Sithumela le imeyili ngoba othile ucele ukususa i-akhawunti ye-Vaultara yaleli kheli.
